historical_protocol.boundary_text: No formal/heldout/P4/PPO_ALLOWED release; energy failures retained; no automatic rerun, seed change, batch selection, or budget extension; technical/safety anomaly or accepted update zero are stop conditions.
historical_protocol.boundary_line_refs: larger_batch_protocol:1-3, execution/result paragraphs near the end

protocol_association_correction.fact: The learning-curve protocol parameters are not the batch-04 larger-batch protocol parameters; batch-04 summary matches the larger-batch protocol values gamma=1, lambda=1, reward_scale=.01, minibatch=128, four batches of 24.

step_schema.fact: StudentStepV42 stores one scalar reward and one value/next_value pair; it has no normal/emergency/failed outcome channel.

team_gae.fact: delta uses row.reward plus gamma*next_value minus value; full-episode mode uses gamma=1 and lambda=1 through joint_batch._full_episode_mc_returns and team_gae.

full_episode_return.fact: Returns reset at episode_end and accumulate scalar row.reward backward; the computed return is required to match team_gae.

actor_application.fact: Advantages are normalized over steps with any actor row, then repeated for each actor row in active worlds; joint_team sums per-agent clipped objectives and divides by one rollout-wide actor-count normalizer.

outcome_signal_separation.fact: Normal/emergency/failed counts are recorded as evaluation/metrics fields; no separate normal, emergency, or failed term is passed into gate advantage. Their effect enters only through the scalar environment reward if present in that step.
outcome_signal_separation.test_refs: tests/test_p3_task_neutral_joint_batch.py:182-199 verifies failed_energy is retained and is not a training stop; tests/test_p3_task_neutral_joint_batch.py:224-244 verifies episode-boundary full-episode returns.

actor_world_weighting.fact: Actor observations are selected by actor_mask; each world receives equal mass and its actor rows split that mass.

trainable_parameters.optimizer: fresh Adam constructed over the trainable parameters
